children.text: Introduction (My Dream)
children.cn: 介绍（我的梦想）

children.text: When we are young, we can dream about anything.
children.cn: 当我们年轻时，我们可以梦想任何事情。
children.notes: When we are young: 当我们年轻时（时间状语从句）; dream about: 梦想，梦见
children.explanation: dream about/of 表示“梦想；梦见”，后面接名词或代词。

children.text: As a middle school student, I want to become a computer programmer in the future.
children.cn: 作为一名中学生，我未来想成为一名电脑程序员。
children.notes: as: 作为; want to become: 想要成为; computer programmer: 电脑程序员; in the future: 在未来
children.statement: “programmer” 指的是电脑硬件工程师。
children.explanation: “programmer” 意为“程序员，程序编写员”，由动词 program 加后缀 -er 构成。
children.keywords: middle school student, want to become, computer programmer, in the future

children.text: I hope to make useful software to help people with their daily lives.
children.cn: 我希望能制作有用的软件来帮助人们的日常生活。
children.notes: hope to do sth.: 希望做某事; useful software: 有用的软件; help sb. with sth.: 在某方面帮助某人; daily lives: 日常生活
children.statement: “help sb. with sth.” 是一个固定搭配，意为“在某事上帮助某人”。
children.explanation: help sb. with sth. 相当于 help sb. (to) do sth.，表示帮助某人做某事或在某方面提供帮助。
children.keywords: hope to make, useful software, help people with, daily lives

children.text: Action Plans
children.cn: 行动计划

children.text: To make this dream come true, I am going to start with small steps.
children.cn: 为了让这个梦想成真，我打算从小步开始迈进。
children.notes: make... come true: 使……成真; be going to do: 打算做某事; start with: 从……开始; small steps: 小步子，小举措
children.statement: “make this dream come true” 中的 “come true” 可以用于被动语态。
children.explanation: come true 是不及物动词短语，意为“实现，成真”，不能用于被动语态，常作宾语补足语或系表结构。
children.keywords: make dream come true, am going to, start with, small steps

children.text: First, I will study math and science hard to build a strong foundation.
children.cn: 首先，我将努力学习数学和科学，打下坚实的基础。
children.notes: study hard: 努力学习; build a strong foundation: 打下坚实的基础
children.statement: “First” 在句中作为顺序连接词，引出第一个行动要点。
children.explanation: First 常用于写作中罗列要点，使文章条理更加清晰。
children.keywords: First, study math, science hard, build strong foundation

children.text: Next, I plan to learn basic coding online every weekend.
children.cn: 接下来，我计划每个周末在网上学习基础编程。
children.notes: plan to do sth.: 计划做某事; basic coding: 基础编程; online: 在线地; every weekend: 每个周末
children.statement: “plan to do sth.” 表示“计划做某事”。
children.explanation: plan 后面通常接动词不定式 to do，表示未来的计划或打算。
children.keywords: Next, plan to learn, basic coding, online, every weekend

children.text: Also, I am going to read books about technology to broaden my mind.
children.cn: 此外，我还打算阅读有关科技的书籍来开阔视野。
children.notes: Also: 而且，此外; books about technology: 关于科技的书籍; broaden one's mind: 开阔视野/心胸
children.statement: “broaden my mind” 意为“开阔我的视野/胸襟”。
children.explanation: broaden 是动词，意为“拓宽，变宽”，broaden one's mind/horizon 表示开阔眼界。
children.keywords: Also, am going to read, technology, broaden my mind

children.text: Conclusion & Resolution
children.cn: 总结与决心

children.text: Although the journey may be difficult, I will never give up.
children.cn: 尽管前路可能困难重重，但我绝不会放弃。
children.notes: Although: 尽管，虽然（引导让步状语从句）; journey: 旅程，历程; give up: 放弃
children.statement: 在英语中，“Although” 可以和 “but” 在同一个复合句中连用。
children.explanation: although 和 but 不能同时出现在同一个句子中，两者只能保留其一。
children.keywords: Although, journey difficult, will never give up

children.text: I believe small daily efforts will turn my big dream into reality.
children.cn: 我相信每天微小的努力终将把我的大梦想变为现实。
children.notes: believe: 相信; daily efforts: 每日的努力; turn... into reality: 把……变成现实
children.explanation: turn A into B 表示将 A 转化为或变成 B，此处指将梦想变为现实。
children.keywords: believe, small daily efforts, turn big dream into reality

children.text: Introduction (My Dream)
children.cn: 介绍（我的梦想）

children.text: When we are young, we can dream about anything.
children.cn: 当我们年轻时，我们可以梦想任何事情。
children.notes: When we are young: 当我们年轻时（时间状语从句）; dream about: 梦想，梦见
children.explanation: dream about/of 表示“梦想；梦见”，后面接名词或代词。

children.text: As a middle school student, I have always dreamed of becoming an excellent software engineer.
children.cn: 作为一名中学生，我一直梦想着成为一名优秀的软件工程师。
children.notes: have always dreamed of: 一直梦想着（现在完成时）; excellent: 优秀的; software engineer: 软件工程师
children.statement: “dreamed of becoming” 中 of 是介词，后面动词使用 -ing 形式。
children.explanation: 介词 of 后面跟动词时必须使用动名词形式（v-ing）。
children.keywords: middle school student, dreamed of becoming, excellent software engineer

children.text: I hope to develop innovative programs that can solve real-world problems and improve people's lives.
children.cn: 我希望能开发出创新的程序，以解决现实世界中的问题并改善人们的生活。
children.notes: innovative programs: 创新程序; that can solve: 定语从句修饰 programs; real-world problems: 现实世界的问题; improve people's lives: 改善人们的生活
children.statement: “that can solve real-world problems” 是一个定语从句。
children.explanation: that 引导定语从句，在从句中作主语，先行词是 programs。
children.keywords: develop innovative programs, solve real-world problems, improve lives

children.text: Action Plans
children.cn: 行动计划

children.text: However, big dreams cannot be achieved without practical plans and consistent actions.
children.cn: 然而，没有切实可行的计划和持之以恒的行动，宏伟的梦想是无法实现的。
children.notes: However: 然而（副词）; cannot be achieved: 无法被实现（含情态动词的被动语态）; practical plans: 切实可行的计划; consistent actions: 持之以恒的行动
children.statement: “cannot be achieved” 是被动语态结构。
children.explanation: 情态动词 + be + 过去分词（cannot be achieved）构成情态动词的被动语态。
children.keywords: However, cannot be achieved without, practical plans, consistent actions

children.text: First of all, I am going to study math and computer science harder to master key knowledge.
children.cn: 首先，我打算更加努力地学习数学和计算机科学，以掌握关键知识。
children.notes: First of all: 首先，第一; computer science: 计算机科学; master: 掌握; key knowledge: 关键知识
children.statement: “master” 在句中用作名词，意为“主人”。
children.explanation: 在句中 master 是及物动词，意为“精通；掌握”。
children.keywords: First of all, study math, computer science harder, master key knowledge

children.text: Furthermore, I plan to take online programming courses and practice writing code every weekend.
children.cn: 此外，我计划参加在线编程课程，并在每个周末练习写代码。
children.notes: Furthermore: 此外，而且; take courses: 上课，选修课程; practice doing: 练习做某事; writing code: 编写代码
children.statement: “practice” 后面接动词时，必须用动名词（doing）形式。
children.explanation: practice doing sth. 是固定用法，practice 后接动名词作宾语，不能接不定式。
children.keywords: Furthermore, plan to take, online programming courses, practice writing code

children.text: In addition, I will read books about technology to expand my horizon and keep up with new ideas.
children.cn: 另外，我将阅读有关技术的书籍以开阔眼界，并紧跟新思想的步伐。
children.notes: In addition: 此外，另外; expand one's horizon: 开阔眼界; keep up with: 跟上……的步伐
children.statement: “keep up with” 意为“跟上，赶上”。
children.explanation: keep up with 是常用动词短语，表示在步伐、知识或进展上保持同步。
children.keywords: In addition, read books, technology, expand horizon, keep up with

children.text: Conclusion & Resolution
children.cn: 总结与决心

children.text: Even if I face challenges along the way, I will remain confident and persist to the end.
children.cn: 即使一路上面临挑战，我也会保持自信并坚持到底。
children.notes: Even if: 即使，纵然（引导让步状语从句）; face challenges: 面临挑战; remain confident: 保持自信; persist to the end: 坚持到底
children.statement: “remain” 在这里是连系动词，后接形容词 “confident” 作表语。
children.explanation: remain 作为连系动词，意为“保持；依然处于某种状态”，后接形容词作表语。
children.keywords: Even if, face challenges along the way, remain confident, persist to the end

children.text: As long as I take small steps every day, my big dream will surely come true.
children.cn: 只要我每天迈出小小的步伐，我的宏伟梦想就一定会成真。
children.notes: As long as: 只要（引导条件状语从句）; take small steps: 迈出小步; surely: 一定，无疑; come true: 实现
children.statement: “As long as” 引导条件状语从句，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时表将来（主将从现）。
children.explanation: 在 as long as 引导的条件状语从句中，遵循“主将从现”原则，从句使用一般现在时（take），主句使用一般将来时（will come true）。
children.keywords: As long as, take small steps, big dream surely come true
